name: agent-review-04-did-you-create-a-link
goal: The person asks what happened in a conversation that actually did it. The answer leads with who did what, and nothing new is created.
brief: You asked for a link, you pressed Confirm, and now you want to know whether the assistant made it or you did.

messages.text: I need one more link I can open to try the Larkmead new patient sign-up myself.

seed.requires: The form published to test with one link on it, so the question is asked about a link this conversation itself put up and the person confirmed.

assistantMust: lead with who did what: the person confirmed a plan, and the step ran
never claim the act for itself: not "I created", not "I made"
not propose anything, because the question is a question
say the address was shown once and cannot be read back

notes: The question is only answerable from the conversation, so the scenario creates the link itself rather than resting on the one scenario 2 left behind: an assistant with no history can only guess. A reply that corrects the record before it answers the question fails this scenario even when every fact in it is right.
